Let's use actual software formula. Many tools (e.g., MDAnalysis, Biopython) compute dihedral using atan2 of cross products. Let's look up Biopython's calc_dihedral more precisely. I remember:
def calc_dihedral(v1, v2, v3, v4):
    """Calculate the dihedral angle between four atoms."""
    ab = v2 - v1
    bc = v3 - v2
    cd = v4 - v3
    u = ab.cross(bc)
    v = bc.cross(cd)
    w = u.cross(v)
    angle = atan2(w.dot(bc.normalized()), u.dot(v))
    return degrees(angle)
